newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Baesa says fails to make debt payment.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Baesa says fails to make debt payment.

text.p: Buenos Aires Embotelladora SA (BAESA), Pepsi Co's biggest bottler outside the United States, said Wednesday it failed to pay about $500 million in debt obligations that were due March 31.

The debt is part of a "standstill agreement" signed last year with creditors, which allowed BAESA to defer payments until March 31 this year. BAESA is in negotiations with creditors over a long-term restructuring plan, the firm said in a statement to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange.
